headline: TEX @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 4.26 at HOU 3.36, with a projected total of 7.62. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TEX: TEX moved -0.59 runs while HOU moved -0.98, changing the projected margin by +0.39 runs. The projected total fell -1.57, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +11.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Nathan Eovaldi has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Braden Shewmake, Ezequiel Duran, Yordan Alvarez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Corey Seager, Cam Smith because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
